captureMethod: Authenticated replies-inclusive profile traversal to exhaustion, posts-only and authored-search cross-checks, canonical-status deduplication, and explicit separation of rendered conversation context.
boundaries: The profile reported 183 posts; 181 account-timeline items were recovered and two remain unrecovered.
Seven public conversation records rendered within the replies-inclusive surface are preserved separately and excluded from the account-post denominator.
Public contact numbers were redacted from committed text.
Authenticated analytics links and personal interaction-state labels were excluded.
No direct messages, settings, private analytics, cookies, tokens, session identifiers, browser storage, credentials, or private follower data were captured.
